references.text: Contrasting portrayals of the father's role in marriage: one negotiating a price (Gen 34), the other defending his daughter's rights after the violation of the marital bond (Deut 22).
A profound contrast in fathers' responses to violence: one father sacrifices his daughter to save her husband (Judg 19), while the other tries to buy freedom from the consequences of rape (Gen 34).
Theological contrast between God's holy covenant with His bride (Isa 62) and human-distorted marriage as a transaction following violence (Gen 34).
